description: Splits, adds and merges a stereo or 3D signal in 2HP: three monophonic inputs and a polyphonic input are added channel by channel, and each sum reaches both a monophonic and a polyphonic output

params.text: Adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the output vector in 3D

inputs.text: A polyphonic input whose first three channels are taken as x, y and z; further channels are ignored and missing channels count as 0V
Added to the first channel of the polyphonic input to make the X sum; a polyphonic cable here is summed to a single voltage first
Added to the second channel of the polyphonic input to make the Y sum; a polyphonic cable here is summed to a single voltage first
Added to the third channel of the polyphonic input to make the Z sum; a polyphonic cable here is summed to a single voltage first

outputs.text: The three sums as one polyphonic signal; channels past the output channel count are dropped and any extra ones carry 0V, and the count appears on the panel display
The X input added to the first channel of the polyphonic input
The Y input added to the second channel of the polyphonic input
The Z input added to the third channel of the polyphonic input

menu: Output channels — sets the polyphonic output to 1 to 16 channels, and the count appears on the panel display
Follow input channel count — sizes the polyphonic output from the patched inputs instead of the Output channels slider
Insert Tricorder on right — adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the outgoing vector in 3D
